cases.name: put-image-data
cases.html: <!doctype html><body style='margin:0;background:#fff'><canvas id=c width=60 height=60></canvas><script>var x=document.getElementById('c').getContext('2d');var d=x.createImageData(40,30);for(var i=0;i<40*30;i++){d.data[i*4]=(i%40)*6;d.data[i*4+1]=Math.floor(i/40)*8;d.data[i*4+2]=128;d.data[i*4+3]=255;}x.putImageData(d,10,15);window.__done=true;</script>
